args.command: Get-ChildItem -Path gelen -Recurse -Include *.jpg, *.jpeg, *.png, *.mp4, *.mov | ForEach-Object { $file = $_; $fileName = $file.Name; $extension = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($fileName); if ($extension -match '\.(jpg|jpeg|png|mp4|mov)$' -or $fileName -match '^\w{3,}_(\d{8}|\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})_.*(\.(jpg|jpeg|png|mp4|mov))$') { $dateMatch = [regex]::Match($fileName, '(\d{8})|(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})'); if ($dateMatch.Success) { $dateString = if ($dateMatch.Groups[1].Success) {$dateMatch.Groups[1].Value} else {$dateMatch.Groups[2].Value}; $dateParts = $dateString -replace '-', ''; $year = $dateParts.Substring(0, 4); $month = $dateParts.Substring(4, 2); $targetDir = "arsiv\$year\$month"; if (-not (Test-Path $targetDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetDir | Out-Null }; Move-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetDir -Force } else { $targetDir = "arsiv\tarihsiz"; if (-not (Test-Path $targetDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetDir | Out-Null }; Move-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetDir -Force } } }
